parrafo.es: H&N Tree Service poda, recorta y remueve arboles y palmas en Homestead y el sur de Miami-Dade, con triturado de tocones incluido. Calificacion 5.0 en Google con 42 resenas.

parrafo_1.es: H&N Tree Service es un equipo de Homestead especializado en el cuidado de arboles y palmas. Trabajamos con camion de canasta propio para llegar a las ramas altas sin arriesgar tu techo ni tu cerca.
parrafo_1.en: H&N Tree Service is a Homestead based crew specialized in tree and palm care. We run our own bucket truck to reach high limbs without putting your roof or fence at risk.

parrafo_2.es: Del recorte de rutina a la limpieza despues de una tormenta: cortamos, trituramos los tocones y nos vamos dejando el patio limpio.
parrafo_2.en: From routine trimming to storm cleanup: we cut, grind the stumps, and leave the yard clean when we go.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que arbol o palma necesita atencion. Respondemos rapido por telefono, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us which tree or palm needs attention. We answer fast by phone, no forms.

texto.es: Vamos a tu propiedad a ver el arbol, la altura y el acceso antes de decir nada.
texto.en: We come to your property to see the tree, the height and the access before saying anything.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro para el trabajo: poda, remocion o triturado de tocones.
texto.en: We give you a clear price for the job: trimming, removal or stump grinding.

texto.es: Cortamos con el camion de canasta, trituramos y limpiamos el patio antes de irnos.
texto.en: We cut with the bucket truck, grind the stump and clean up the yard before we leave.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el arbol y el acceso. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree and the access. Call and we will give you a price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Poda de arboles y palmas para que crezcan sanos y no amenacen tu techo ni tu cerca.
texto.en: Tree and palm trimming so they grow healthy and stop threatening your roof or fence.

texto.es: Remocion completa de arboles enfermos, muertos o que ya no caben en el patio, con camion de canasta propio.
texto.en: Full removal of sick, dead or oversized trees, with our own bucket truck.

texto.es: Trituramos el tocon para que no quede un obstaculo en el cesped.
texto.en: We grind the stump down so it does not stay in the way of your lawn.

texto.es: Retiro de ramas caidas y arboles danados despues de una tormenta.
texto.en: Removal of fallen branches and storm-damaged trees after a storm.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llama igual, atendemos casos puntuales.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call anyway, we handle one off jobs too.

items.quote: We had about 20 unhealthy palm trees removed, some completely rotten. This company was incredibly responsive, professional, and kind throughout the whole process.
Henry is professional, communicative, and on time. Did an excellent job grinding a stomp and cleaning up some palms. I will definitely use him again. He is my now go to anything tree related.
I am so pleased with the service provided by Henry and his crew at H&N tree services!
